theme: TPI-1/TPI-2 fn-valued tuple components; dyn Trait
text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): a tuple pattern component that is a fn value (its element is fn(i64) -> i64, so its numeric param and return are free vars) is now checked when called through CS2-6: a param that is a component var is compared as its element leaf, and a return that is one is bound to the call's use, which the component's obligation checks by kind. So f("s") or f(1) + "s" with (f, b) on (inc, 2) is E0102 at check instead of a run panic (each let twin is refused); numbers stay at any width (f(y) with y: u8, let x: u8 = f(1) check clean). A numeric component used as dyn Trait is no longer refused (its let twin checks clean): let d: dyn Greet = a, a dyn param or a dyn return check and run as on the base binary. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes as the base binary.
